example.title: Kansas Homestead of Thomas McQuill(i)an, barn
example.place: Willow Springs vicinity, Douglas County, KS

brief: Tall two-storey gable barn about 30 ft by 35 ft, pegged walnut frame on a stone foundation, sided in wide vertical boards weathered to silver-grey, under a steep standing-seam metal roof from the 1950s gone rusty in streaks. A one-storey shed-roofed extension about 20 ft long runs off the west gable end, clad partly in corrugated metal with rust-red roofing. The long sides have board sliding doors on a pipe track, two sets of Dutch doors and a pair of hinged barn doors with yellowed battens; only a small square loft opening in each gable. Red steel pipe gates and panel corrals enclose the lot around it. (Gable barn with lean-to; nearest vocabulary type is english_three_bay.)
